qr.menu_subtitle: Scan the sign-in QR code on the web
qr.scan_subtitle: Scan the code on the otopoly.app sign-in page
qr.scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code shown on the Otopoly sign-in page on your computer.
qr.not_otopoly_code: This is not an Otopoly sign-in code.
qr.camera_body: Allow camera access to scan the QR code. The camera is only used while scanning.
qr.camera_blocked: Camera access is off. Turn on the camera for Otopoly in Settings.
qr.request_title: Someone wants to sign in on the web
qr.request_body: If you approve, this browser is signed in as {{account}} in {{organization}}.
qr.warning: Only approve a sign-in you started yourself on a screen in front of you. Never approve a code someone sent you.
qr.approve_hint: Signs this browser in with your account
qr.sign_in_first: Sign in to this app first, then scan the QR code again to approve the web sign-in.
qr.select_org_first: Choose a business first, then scan the QR code again to approve the web sign-in.
qr.result_approved: The web session opens in a few seconds.
qr.result_rejected: The web sign-in request was rejected. If it wasn't you, consider changing your password.
qr.result_expired: This QR code is no longer valid or was already used. Scan the new code on the web page.
qr.result_claimed: This QR code was scanned with another account. Create a new code on the web page.
qr.result_resolved: This sign-in request was already approved or rejected.
qr.result_deactivated: This account was deleted, so it can't approve web sign-ins.
qr.result_invalid: This link is not a valid Otopoly sign-in request.
